# E0219: exported name used twice

An exported function's name is its C symbol, and C has one namespace, so no two exported functions of a package share a name. Rename one of them.

- Rule: [`c.exported-names`](../../reference/20-builds.md#c.exported-names)
- Reported at: the name of the second function, in the order of the modules' paths and of the functions in each.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0219_exported_name_used_twice`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0219_exported_name_used_twice):

`main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
fn main() {}
```

`orders.lt`:

```stilt fragment
/// The total of the orders.
pub extern fn total(orders: i64) -> i64 {
  orders
}
```

`refunds.lt`:

```stilt fragment
/// The total of the refunds.
pub extern fn total(refunds: i64) -> i64 {
  -refunds
}
```

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── EXPORTED NAME USED TWICE ─────────────────────────── refunds.lt:2:15  [E0219]

Another exported function of this package is named `total`, and C has one
namespace; rename one:

  2 │ pub extern fn total(refunds: i64) -> i64 {
    │               ^^^^^

An exported function's name is its C symbol, and C has one namespace, so no two
exported functions of a package share a name. Rename one of them.
```
